journeys.name: A comment wakes an agent
journeys.question: What happens after someone mentions an agent?

steps.title: Member posts a comment
steps.happens: The issue page sends the comment with an agent mention.

steps.title: Core sends it
steps.happens: The mutation posts the comment to the API.

steps.title: Request reaches the server
steps.happens: The API client calls REST /api on the router.

steps.title: Auth checks the member
steps.happens: Auth reads the token and the membership.

steps.title: Handler takes the comment
steps.happens: CreateComment validates the body.

steps.title: Comment is stored
steps.happens: The comment row is inserted.

steps.title: Mentions become triggers
steps.happens: The handler parses mentions and finds the agent to wake.

steps.title: A task is queued
steps.happens: EnqueueTaskForMention writes a queued task for the agent.

steps.title: Task row is stored
steps.happens: The task waits in the queue.

steps.title: Clients hear task:queued
steps.happens: After commit the task event goes on the bus.

steps.title: Hub pushes it
steps.happens: The realtime hub sends task:queued to the workspace.

steps.title: Daemon gets a hint
steps.happens: The notifier wakes the daemon hub of the runtime.

steps.title: Hint reaches the daemon
steps.happens: The daemon hub sends daemon:task_available over the socket.

steps.title: Daemon polls now
steps.happens: The wakeup connection kicks the poll loop.

steps.title: Daemon claims
steps.happens: The poll loop claims the task over the socket.

steps.title: Server marks the claim
steps.happens: ClaimTaskForRuntime moves the task to dispatched.

steps.title: Daemon prepares the run
steps.happens: handleTask reports the start and calls runTask.

steps.title: Prompt is built
steps.happens: runTask builds the prompt from the task context.

steps.title: Agent starts
steps.happens: The backend launches the agent CLI with the prompt.
steps.action: Reads the comment and starts the work

steps.title: Agent answers
steps.happens: The agent runs multica issue comment add.
steps.action: Posts its reply as a comment

journeys.name: An answer wakes the asking agent
journeys.question: How does an answer with Wake reach the agent that asked?

steps.title: Member answers
steps.happens: The question card sends the answer with Wake on.

steps.title: Core sends it
steps.happens: The mutation posts the answer.

steps.title: Handler takes the answer
steps.happens: AnswerQuestion passes it to the question service.

steps.title: Answer is checked
steps.happens: ValidateAnswer checks the answer type and policy.

steps.title: Answer is stored
steps.happens: The answer row is written and the status derived.

steps.title: Question event
steps.happens: question:updated goes on the bus.

steps.title: To-dos react
steps.happens: The to-do listeners hear the question event.

steps.title: To-do closes
steps.happens: The answerer's to-do closes.

steps.title: Clients hear todo:closed
steps.happens: The to-do service publishes the close.

steps.title: Wake runs
steps.happens: Answer asks the Wake for the asking agent.

steps.title: Wake intent
steps.happens: With no blockers the wake drains its intent.

steps.title: A task is queued
steps.happens: EnqueueTaskForQuestionWake writes the task.

steps.title: Task row is stored
steps.happens: The task carries the answer anchor in its context.

steps.title: Daemon gets a hint
steps.happens: publishQuestionWake tells clients and the daemon.

steps.title: Hint reaches the daemon
steps.happens: daemon:task_available reaches the runtime.

steps.title: Agent runs
steps.happens: The daemon claims the task and starts the agent.
steps.action: Reads the answer and goes on

journeys.name: A comment steers a running agent
journeys.question: How does a comment reach an agent that is already running?

steps.title: Member posts a comment
steps.happens: The issue page sends a comment for the running agent.

steps.title: Recipients are resolved
steps.happens: The composer decides to steer the running run.

steps.title: Core sends it
steps.happens: The mutation posts the comment.

steps.title: Handler takes the comment
steps.happens: CreateComment stores it.

steps.title: Run is steered
steps.happens: The handler hands the comment to the running run.

steps.title: Run input is delivered
steps.happens: Deliver snapshots the comment for each live run.

steps.title: Receipt is stored
steps.happens: A pending receipt waits for the run.

steps.title: Daemon gets a hint
steps.happens: The notifier sends a supplement hint.

steps.title: Hint reaches the daemon
steps.happens: daemon:task_supplement_available reaches the runtime.

steps.title: Supplement loop wakes
steps.happens: The wakeup connection wakes the supplement loop.

steps.title: Daemon claims it
steps.happens: The loop claims the supplement over REST.

steps.title: Server hands it out
steps.happens: ClaimTaskSupplement marks the receipt delivered.

steps.title: Agent gets the comment
steps.happens: The loop injects the comment into the live turn.

steps.title: Agent acts on it
steps.happens: The agent works the comment into its run.

journeys.name: A member checks an agent's work
journeys.question: How does a check to-do travel from agent to member and back?

steps.title: Agent opens a check
steps.happens: The agent runs multica todo check.
steps.action: Asks for a check of its work

steps.title: CLI sends it
steps.happens: The CLI posts the check.

steps.title: Handler takes it
steps.happens: OpenCheck passes it to the question service.

steps.title: Check is stored
steps.happens: The check is a to-do of kind check.

steps.title: To-do opens
steps.happens: The to-do service publishes the open.

steps.title: Member hears todo:opened
steps.happens: The hub sends the personal event to the member.

steps.title: Inbox shows it
steps.happens: The inbox lists the open to-dos.

steps.title: Member checks
steps.happens: The check body sends pass or feedback.

steps.title: Answer is stored
steps.happens: AnswerCheck commits the result and its delivery.

steps.title: Opener gets a hint
steps.happens: The answer reaches the opening run as run input.

steps.title: Agent reads the answer
steps.happens: The supplement loop injects it into the run.

journeys.name: An agent waits for a release
journeys.question: How does a release wakeup start an agent later?

steps.title: Member places issues
steps.happens: The release page adds issues to the release.

steps.title: Line is stored
steps.happens: AddIssuesToRelease writes the release line.

steps.title: Workspace hears release_line:updated
steps.happens: Every Timeline refetches the line.

steps.title: Agent schedules a wakeup
steps.happens: The agent runs multica release.
steps.action: Asks to wake when the release is ready

steps.title: Wakeup is created
steps.happens: CreateReleaseWakeup stores the rule.

steps.title: Clock ticks
steps.happens: The scheduler runs the wakeup job.

steps.title: Condition holds
steps.happens: The wakeup service finds the due rule.

steps.title: A task is queued
steps.happens: The wakeup queues a task for the agent.

steps.title: Daemon gets a hint
steps.happens: The task reaches its runtime.

journeys.name: A release page shows the owner's runs
journeys.question: How does the owner's run reach an open release page?

steps.title: Member opens the release
steps.happens: The release page asks for the release's runs.

steps.title: Request reaches the server
steps.happens: The API client calls GET /api/releases/{id}/tasks.

steps.title: Auth checks the member
steps.happens: Auth reads the token and the membership.

steps.title: Handler lists the runs
steps.happens: ListReleaseTasks loads the release in the workspace.

steps.title: Runs are read
steps.happens: The release's runs return newest first with their usage and wakeup events.

steps.title: A run starts or ends
steps.happens: The workspace hears task events.

steps.title: Sync hears the event
steps.happens: Realtime sync takes the task event.

steps.title: Release runs refetch
steps.happens: Realtime sync invalidates every release's runs, so the page shows the run without a reload.

steps.title: Member stops a run
steps.happens: Stop cancels the run after the member confirms.

journeys.name: Products reach Multica
journeys.question: How do the brain's Organisations and Products become organisations and projects?

steps.title: Brian runs product sync
steps.happens: multica_projects.py starts.

steps.title: Brain is read
steps.happens: read_brain reads Organisations and Products from Anytype.

steps.title: Plan is written
steps.happens: write_plan applies the diff.

steps.title: API calls
steps.happens: The Multica API client sends the changes.

steps.title: Request reaches the server
steps.happens: Each call goes to REST /api with a PAT.

steps.title: Organisation is created
steps.happens: CreateOrganisation stores it.

steps.title: Project is created
steps.happens: CreateProject stores it under its organisation.
